description: Explains one test result in depth, from the result reference of a row returned by agent_testing_get_results. Chat: the verdict and its reasons, the evaluation, and the conversation transcript. Voice: which criteria passed or failed with evidence, response latency, a temporary link to the call recording, and the transcript. Phone call: the call analysis, why the call ended, a temporary link to the recording, and the transcript. Image analysis: what matched the prompt and what did not, and a temporary link to the image. In transcripts, tester is the simulated user and agent_under_test is the customer's agent.

includeEvidence.description: Chat: also include the knowledge-base passages the evaluation was grounded on (default false; large).

includeTranscript.description: Include the conversation transcript (default true). Set false when only the verdict, criteria, latency or recording is needed.

result.description: The "result" value of a row returned by agent_testing_get_results, copied exactly.

name: agent_testing_explain_result
title: Explain Agent Testing Result
